instruction.name: xvaddwev.q.du.d
instruction.description: Add the even-positioned unsigned 64-bit elements in `a` and the corresponding signed 64-bit elements in `b`, extending both to 128-bit, and save the 128-bit result in `dst`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Dependent vector-register chain with small positive integer element values.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
